sources.games: 660 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 44.8%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py ursa.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Abyssal Blade, Battle Fury.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast. High-rank Ursa players against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 34% of 55 games against them (20% otherwise), won 63% against 31%.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 84% (4), phase_boots 76% (6), power_treads 24% (6), pers 97% (10), bfury 99% (14), basher 93% (22), black_king_bar 63% (25), aghanims_shard 63% (27), ultimate_scepter 29% (30), sange 61% (31), abyssal_blade 56% (33), monkey_king_bar 27% (33), swift_blink 30% (40).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 80.0%+: 25:00 16000 (102 games, 80.4%), 30:00 20500 (53 games, 84.9%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold. No 85% line for this hero (two of the three minutes needed): the hero's own 80% line (scripts/hero_item_stats.py WIN_TARGETS).

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

suppress.illusions: Battle Fury (in his build) cleaves the illusions around his target. High-rank Ursa players do not buy Maelstrom against illusion heroes (50 games: it is not among the items they buy more often there).
suppress.break: Abyssal Blade is in his build; high-rank Ursas against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: Silver Edge not among the 12 items bought more often in 34 games against them, Abyssal Blade 50% of 34 games against them (38% otherwise), won 71% against 35%.

skills.basis: 660 games: maxed ursa_fury_swipes > ursa_overpower > ursa_earthshock 555 (win 45.2%), ursa_overpower > ursa_fury_swipes > ursa_earthshock 86 (win 52.3%), ursa_fury_swipes > ursa_overpower 15 (win 0.0%); talents 10: Fury Swipes Reset Time 514/660 (44.6%), +1.75 Mana Regen 146/660 (45.9%); 15: Enrage Status Resistance 466/630 (48.1%), Maul Health As Damage 164/630 (43.3%); 20: Fury Swipes Damage 409/447 (53.5%), Earthshock Radius 38/447 (57.9%); 25: Overpower Attacks 182/202 (68.7%), Earthshock has Charges 20/202 (45.0%).
